description.text: Class will be open only with minimum of 8 students. Summer classes: mid June thru mid September, students may enroll any time. Curriculum 2-week Short-term Chinese Language Training Class Monday 8:10 - 9:30 Screening Test 9:50-11:20 Comprehensive Chinese 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice (Listening oriented) Tuesday 8:10 - 9:30 Comprehensive Chinese 9:50-11:20 Comprehensive Chinese 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice*(Speaking oriented) Wednesday 8:10 - 9:30 Spoken Chinese 9:50-11:20 Listening Comprehension 13:30- 16:00 Special Topics ** Thursday 8:10 - 9:30 Comprehensive Chinese 9:50-11:20 Comprehensive Chinese 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice (Listening oriented) Friday 8:10 - 9:30 Spoken Chinese 9:50-11:20 Listening Comprehension 13:30- 16:00 Language Practice*(Speaking oriented) Language Practice Class includes Situation Language Practice, Daily Chinese, Listening Practice, etc. Special Topics include Chinese Culture, Taiqi Boxing, Folk Custom, Calligraphy, Drama, Martial Arts, History, Economy, Politics, Geography, Painting, etc.

duration.text: The Summer Course at Jilin University is a 2 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 222 USD/In total ￥ 1600 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese,if not, it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized.
